passives.name: Project: Destroyer
passives.description: (Passive Effect) At the start of battle, grants an irremovable reduced damage taken to the caster for [Buff_T_tower_very_hard_common_dmg_reduce_single] turn(s) and increases Priority by 100%. Until inflicted with Break, inflicts an irremovable Silenced on all enemies. Reduces Weakness Gauge damage taken from skills other than Burst Skills, Dual Attacks, and Skill Chains by [Buff_V_4086001_4_13]. When an enemy performs an action, if the caster is inflicted with a debuff, increases Priority of the caster by [Buff_V_tower_very_hard_boss_2000075_4_2].
